ops.title: Codex native Bash read completeness fix verified
ops.body:
Outcome

Implemented the reviewed native Codex Bash read-completeness fix without changing patch reconstruction, packaging, documentation, versions, or neighboring repositories. Source remains uncommitted and is ready to freeze for the final Captain Hook build.

Change

- `captain_hook/file_operations.py:119#mhv2` now treats a string PostToolUse `tool_response` as the delivered output only when `evt.host == "codex"`.
- The existing event gate remains mandatory, structured responses still require `exit_code == 0`, Claude string responses still require their prior success wrapper, and every accepted shape still has to equal `path.read_text()` byte-for-text.
- `tests/test_codex_shell_reads.py` records the actual captured Codex 0.155.1 PostToolUse fields and covers exact raw output, PreToolUse rejection, truncated raw output, structured nonzero output, pipes, redirects, subshells, and command substitution.

Reproduction and proof

Before the change, replaying `/tmp/capt-hook-native-payload.json` produced `FileRead(..., requested_full=True, complete=False)` for a successful native `cat sample.txt` whose `tool_response` was `"alpha\nbeta\n"`.

After the change, replaying the same captured payload produces `FileRead(..., requested_full=True, complete=True)`. The file must still exist and its current text must equal the delivered string exactly; partial output remains incomplete.

Verification

- `UV_NO_SYNC=1 uv run pytest tests/test_codex_shell_reads.py tests/test_codex_hosts.py tests/test_patch_file_images.py --deselect=tests/test_codex_hosts.py::test_native_manifest_covers_supported_events`: 49 passed, 1 deselected.
- `UV_NO_SYNC=1 uv run pytest tests/test_events.py tests/test_conditions.py tests/test_testing.py tests/test_codex_shell_reads.py tests/test_patch_file_images.py`: 544 passed.
- `UV_NO_SYNC=1 uv run ruff check captain_hook/file_operations.py tests/test_codex_shell_reads.py`: passed.
- Added-comment audit on both owned paths: no comment lines.
- No Markdown changed in this follow-up, so there was no changed Markdown for slop-cop to check.

Limits

The isolated native capture was reused rather than invoking another model turn. The whole repository `make` gate, packaging validation, signing, installation, live app activation, and three-surface rollout were outside this narrow follow-up; the coordinator's final integrated build owns those gates.

Modified files

captain_hook/file_operations.py
tests/test_codex_shell_reads.py
